summary: Berner Industrier AB engages in the technology distribution, and energy and environment business in Sweden, Norway, Finland, and Denmark. It is involved in the technology and distribution business, that includes water purification, packaging equipment, vibration dampening, technical plastics, and process technology. The company also provides energy and environment products, such as electric boilers, high pressure pumps, food and pharmaceutical pumps, industrial dampers, sound isolation, and noise-reducing control cabins. In addition, it offers wear parts and noisy machinery for industrial corporates; dosing pumps; disinfection system; food packaging and related packaging materials; vibration-damping products, such as ballast and sleeper mats for vibration insulation, structure-borne noise, and impact sound attenuation. The company was formerly known as Christian Berner Tech Trade AB (publ) and changed its name to Berner Industrier AB in May 2024. The company was founded in 1897 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
